rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the pages’ OWN TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber -- pdfplumber.extract_words() returns 266, 275, 256, 266 and 287 words on pages 24-28, so these pages carry their own characters and no recognition was involved
rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2015`, PDF pages 24-28 of the FY2015 annual town report -- the Town Accountant's schedule. READ FROM THE TEXT LAYER, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 266/275/256/266/287 words on the five pages and no page carries an image, so the characters are in the file. FIVE MONEY COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER and measured off the right edge of the figures, which sits at the same x on all five pages: APPROPRIATED FORWARD (x1=331), TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE (407), TOTAL EXPENDED (471), TOTAL ENCUMBERED (521), BALANCE TO REVENUE (571). A narrow flag column carries `fwd`. STRUCTURE READ OFF INDENTATION, NOT OFF ARITHMETIC: a department's detail lines are indented about 4pt from the top-level x0 of their page (73.3 on p24, 73.8 p25, 73.5 p26, 75.5 p27, 73.5 p28); a subtotal row prints no label at all (or is labelled `Total Insurance`); an ALL-CAPS unfigured row is a section heading. A block ends at its subtotal, and a vertical gap of 14pt or more starts a new one -- except immediately before a subtotal, because p26's Highway Labor prints a blank line above its total. WHAT CLOSES, ALL TO THE CENT: 176 department-subtotal column checks (every detail line adds to the printed subtotal in each column the subtotal prints and at least one line carries); 76 of 76 subtotal and standalone rows that print a balance state available - expended - encumbered = balance to revenue; and all FIVE columns add down the run to the printed GRAND TOTAL $32,216,220.58 / $32,216,220.58 / $31,867,964.61 / $265,386.55 / $82,869.42. A `fwd` LINE IS A LINE OF THE COLUMN, not an annotation: every department's printed subtotal includes its forward line, and the 16 forward lines add to the $233,181.84 the last page prints as `fwd - forward from FY 2014` -- proved separately in `fy2015-p24-appropriations-carryforward.csv`. That figure is also FY2014's own printed TOTAL ENCUMBERED, read in `fy2014-p24-appropriations.csv`, so the two years agree about what crossed between them. A BARE INTEGER IS NOT MONEY: the folio at the page foot prints `25` and `27` inside the APPROPRIATED column, not in the last one, so filtering it by column would have missed it; a figure here always carries a `$`. THE EXISTING FY2015 `read` CORRECTION ROWS IN `table-corrections.csv` ARE CONFIRMED BY THIS READ: p24 line 38 Town Clerk's Administration $525.00, p25 line 13 Art 11/07 ATM Master Plan Consulting $2,933.05, p25 line 37 Police Fire Medical Expenses $5,538.85, p27 line 35 Registration of Veteran's Graves $400.00, p27 line 41 School Encumbered Funds FY 14 $41,655.60 and p28 line 9 Other Expenses (Town Reports) $6,338.86 all print exactly those values in the APPROPRIATED FORWARD column.
